channel.title: Block Club Chicago - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Block Club Chicago (blockclubchicago.org)

item.title: Family Asks For Help Finding Unhoused Man Who Went Missing After Illness
item.description: José Rivera Santiago had been living on the street after losing his apartment and has not been heard from since late November. His family is asking for help in finding him.

item.title: Gino And Marty’s Owners Sued By State Over Unpaid Wages
item.description: State officials allege owners and managers of the West Loop restaurant failed to pay workers earned wages, tips, minimum wage and overtime, leaving at least nine employees owed more than $20,000.

item.title: South Side Catholic School Teacher With History Of Child Molestation Allegations Charged In 2 Suburbs
item.description: Brett Smith has been charged with criminal sexual abuse in Orland Park and battery in Evergreen Park, police said. He was most recently a substitute teacher at Queen of Martyrs Elementary.

item.title: As Death Rates Rise Among Pregnant Black Women, South Side Orgs Launch Free Doula Services
item.description: The free program offered by Chicago Birthworks Collective and the state-funded South Side Healthy Community Organization is a “preventive measure,” organizers said. There are 80 slots available for families seeking services.

item.title: New Sound Cafe In Austin Channels The Legacy Of Iconic 1970s Gospel Record Store
item.description: The coffee shop opened in the same building that housed New Sound Gospel Records and Tapes until it closed over 20 years ago — and it includes many nods to the gospel store's heyday.

item.title: 2 People Shot In Police Parking Lot On West Side
item.description: A man, 19, and woman, 21, were shot Thursday night outside the Austin District station, according to police and media reports. The two were in fair condition at a local hospital.

item.title: Ian McKellen Enchants Chicago Students With Tales Of X-Men And Shakespeare
item.description: The acclaimed stage and screen actor, well known to movie audiences as Magneto from "X-Men" and Gandalf from "Lord of the Rings," regaled the crowd during a benefit performance at the Chicago Shakespeare Theater.

item.title: Chatham Artist’s Billboard Campaign Removed Without Notice: ‘This Is Messed Up’
item.description: Isiah ‘ThoughtPoet’ Veney was surprised to find his art taken down a month earlier than he expected, a move the company behind the billboard placement said was a “mixup and miscommunication."

item.title: Anti-ICE Protesters Crowd Downtown Streets For General Strike: ‘Money Talks’
item.description: Hundreds participated in a Chicago protest Friday evening after federal immigration crackdowns led to two fatal shootings in Minneapolis.

item.title: Johnson Orders Police To Investigate Immigrant Agents’ Alleged Crimes For Possible Prosecution
item.description: The 'ICE On Notice' executive order provides a framework for police and the Mayor's Office to document and investigate alleged wrongdoing by immigration officers so they can be held criminally accountable, Mayor Brandon Johnson's office said.
